title: Layer 5 Runtime Seam Design Gate
scope_label: DESIGN ONLY. DOCS / TESTS ONLY. NO IMPLEMENTATION. NO RUNTIME WIRING.

design_summary.layer5_purpose: Structural seam between Layer 4 bridge output and runtime waterfall. Enforces POLICY_TABLE discipline and gates promotion. Read-only adapter. No waterfall logic, no persistence, no feature flag flip, no formula changes.
layer5_owns: POLICY_TABLE enforcement at the structural level
design_summary.differs_from_layer4_bridge: Layer 4 is a pure domain function; Layer 5 is a structural adapter. Layer 4 produces OpeningBalanceBridgeResult; Layer 5 enforces policy and gates promotion.
design_summary.differs_from_waterfall_runtime: Waterfall owns CFADS, debt service, tax, depreciation, P&L, balance sheet. Layer 5 owns policy enforcement only.

shl_idc_keur.c8_seam_behavior: Read-only exposed; not auto-routed; per-field promotion required

shl_amount_keur.c8_seam_behavior: Read-only exposed; not auto-routed; per-field promotion required

shl_opening_balance_keur.c8_seam_behavior: Read-only exposed; not auto-routed; per-field promotion required

senior_idc_keur.c8_seam_behavior: Read-only exposed; R-PAR-2 blocks promotion; guard rpar2_resolved default False

senior_opening_balance_keur.c8_seam_behavior: REJECTED at seam. Hard rule: frozen fields cannot be promoted by Layer 5.

capex_keur.c8_seam_behavior: REJECTED at seam. Hard rule: frozen fields cannot be promoted by Layer 5.

equity_total_keur.c8_seam_behavior: Composite verified; promotion only when parity_ok AND promotion_requested

rpar2_constraint.description: Senior IDC is computed using an effective rate, not a modelling-correct rate. C1, C2, C7 all treat this as unresolved.
rpar2_constraint.senior_idc_keur_status: replaced for parity tracking, but seam blocks runtime promotion
rpar2_constraint.senior_opening_balance_keur_status: frozen; bridge value differs by +capitalized_senior_idc (TUHO: +1519.564; Oborovo: +1086.032)
rpar2_constraint.parity_drift_treatment: Audit-only; preserved as evidence of asymmetry, not consumed by runtime
rpar2_constraint.promotion_blocked_until: R-PAR-2 closed (modelling-correct rate) OR formally accepted (long-term caveat)

no_promotion_guard.function_signature: assert_no_construction_runtime_promotion(*, field_code: str, policy: str, promotion_requested: bool, rpar2_resolved: bool = False) -> None
no_promotion_guard.c8_implementation: DESIGN ONLY. Function not implemented in C8.

import_contract.test_scope: all files in forbidden-importer list at the time C8 is merged
import_contract.c9_relaxation: C9 will add an exception for the seam module itself (app/services/construction_runtime_seam.py)

c9_may_implement: Audit-only visibility helper (read-only consumer of bridge output)
Tests for seam module and guard
Import-contract test (per C8 §6) plus any updates for the seam module exemption
c9_must_not: Change tax, debt, depreciation, CFADS, or any formula
Mutate use_construction_schedule_engine to True for any project

promotion_path.c9_seam_scaffolding: Seam module + guard. All 11 fields non-promoted. use_construction_schedule_engine=False.
promotion_path.c10_tuho_controlled_promotion: Per-project opt-in for TUHO only. Routes 4 replaced fields (conditional on R-PAR-2 for senior_idc) + 1 derived field. 2 frozen fields explicitly not promoted. TUHO parity baseline unchanged after C10.
promotion_path.c11_oborovo_controlled_promotion: Per-project opt-in for Oborovo only. Same fields as C10. Oborovo parity baseline unchanged after C11.
c10_c11_separation_rationale: Cleaner rollback (failed C10 does not affect C11)

before_c11: TUHO parity baseline unchanged after C10

risk_register.name: double-counting
risk_register.mitigation: POLICY_TABLE + no-promotion guard. Seam routes bridge output as replacement, never addition.

risk_register.name: frozen_field_promotion
risk_register.mitigation: C8 §3.2 hard rule + guard raises PermissionError unconditionally for frozen fields.

risk_register.name: rpar2_leakage
risk_register.mitigation: C8 §4.5 fail-closed default (rpar2_resolved=False). Process gate: R-PAR-2 resolution requires separate workstream PR.

risk_register.name: hidden_runtime_import
risk_register.mitigation: C8 §6 import-contract test (static-AST walk of forbidden-importer files).

risk_register.name: feature_flag_misuse
risk_register.mitigation: C8 §7.2 hard rule + C8 §8.5 per-project opt-in (not global flag flip).

risk_register.name: tax_depreciation_downstream
risk_register.mitigation: C8 §8 promotion gate criteria require parity unchanged (within rounding tolerance).

rationale: C8 is a design gate, not an implementation. C8 produces 3 files (doc + report + test file).
POLICY_TABLE enforcement is structurally specified. Frozen fields are explicitly blocked from promotion.
R-PAR-2 is preserved as a blocking constraint with fail-closed default in the guard.
Import-contract test is specified as static-AST, implementable without runtime changes.
Promotion path is strict and separated (C9 scaffolding -> C10 TUHO -> C11 Oborovo).
unblock_a_requires: Reviewer sign-off on C8 §3 POLICY_TABLE enforcement
Reviewer sign-off on C8 §5.1 guard signature and C8 §5.2 expected behavior
Reviewer sign-off on C8 §8 promotion path
Confirmation that C8 §6 import-contract test is implementable as static-AST
